workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Monaco Find Widget tooltip flickers over buttons in narrow code views
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: prevent narrow Monaco Find tooltip flicker. Target files: packages/components/src/components/sessions/session-monaco-text-viewer.css, packages/components/src/components/sessions/session-monaco-text-viewer.tsx, packages/components/tests/e2e/code-collab-stories-smoke.spec.ts. In the 320 px Session Monaco surface, Monaco 0.55.1 wraps Find action tooltips back over their originating buttons. The tooltip then steals pointer hit-testing, so Monaco repeatedly tears it down and recreates it and the action becomes unreliable to click. (Ref: https://github.com/LodyAI/Lody/pull/750)
